part.text:
Fixed. The bug was in the `shouldComponentUpdate` that `useReducer` installs on components (hooks/src/index.js:240): when a component's pending hook state updates all net out to no change (set then undone on the same tick), it returned `false` unconditionally — bailing out of the render even when the parent had passed new props, discarding them.

The fix makes the SCU not bail out when props actually changed (`this.props !== p`), while preserving the #3731 behavior of skipping updates for pure net-zero state changes.

- `hooks/test/browser/useState.test.js` "respects updates initiated from the parent" (the failing FAIL_TO_PASS test) now passes.
- Verified the exact issue scenario (child sets + unsets state, parent updates prop, same tick) with a temporary test, then removed it.
- Full karma suite passes; the only failure (`should use capturing for event props ending with *Capture`) is pre-existing in a clean tree and unrelated (headless focus event).
